name: multiseed-recall-controls-v1
hypothesis: Explicit record IDs may improve follow-up recall; missing-record failures may persist across seeds.
design: Each seed has one initial positive retrieval, two paired follow-ups sharing its actual assistant response, and one absent-record control. Every generation starts with a fresh cache. Follow-up order alternates by seed. Seed 17 replicates the original setup; seeds 29 and 41 are new. No prompt tuning after observing results.
scoring: Use the existing case-insensitive exact-answer normalization. Report all cases and paired follow-up outcomes conditional on correct initial retrieval. Errors are not scored as incorrect answers.
